name: acra_company_search
description: Search Singapore registered entities (ACRA, Unique Entity Number register) by name or by UEN. Name search matches entities whose name contains every word given. Returns {found, matches_total, companies:[{uen, legal_name, status, legal_form, registration_date, registered_address}], data_as_of, source}. An empty search returns found:false with empty_reason. e.g. {name:"Singapore Airlines"} or {uen:"197200078R"}. Open data: no officers or directors.

name.description: Entity name or words in it, e.g. "DBS Bank".

status.description: Keep only this status as the register states it, e.g. "Registered" or "Deregistered".

name: acra_company_get
description: One Singapore registered entity by UEN. e.g. {uen:"197200078R"}. Returns {found, company:{uen, legal_name, status, legal_form, registration_date, registered_address}, data_as_of, source}; found:false with reason when the UEN is not on the register. Open data: no officers, directors or shareholders.
